oneLine: Israeli carrier Israir is in talks to purchase rival Arkia.

sources.title: Israeli carrier Israir in talks to purchase local rival Arkia

synopsis: Israeli carrier Israir is in preliminary talks to purchase its local rival Arkia in a bid to better compete against foreign carriers. The discussions were revealed by Israir Chief Executive Uri Sirkis in a letter to staff. Arkia, a privately held airline owned by the Nakash brothers, has recently faced a crisis and media reports indicated a loss of $30 million over the first three quarters of 2026, though financial results are not officially published. Arkia is currently working to find solutions and rehabilitate the company. Israir is valued at $144 million. No financial terms or deal values were disclosed in the preliminary talks.
